project: Wuxia Life P44 Habit Trajectory Operator Audit Tooling
description: Create lightweight operator-facing audit tooling so future content waves can detect shaping coverage gaps, legacy-flag drift, and archetype differentiation regressions without large manual audits.

userStories.title: Define operator audit questions and outputs
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an explicit audit contract for the habit trajectory system so tooling output is stable and actionable.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the core audit questions for coverage gaps, legacy-flag drift, archetype imbalance, and recap absorption
Define expected output shape for operator consumption
Save contract under docs/designs/p44-habit-audit-contract.md
Do not change gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Add habit coverage audit script or test surface
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a repeatable way to inspect habit content coverage so future waves can be checked before merge.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a script or test that inventories content by axis and age band
Output highlights missing or low-density zones
Output is readable in terminal and or markdown artifact form
Add regression coverage for the audit output shape

userStories.title: Add legacy flag drift detection
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want tooling that detects when new content accidentally depends on legacy habit flags without documented reason.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect references to training_habit, study_habit, and business_habit in content and logic surfaces
Distinguish allowed compatibility use from suspicious primary dependency where possible
Output suspicious readers clearly
Add targeted regression coverage

userStories.title: Add archetype differentiation audit
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit view of shaping coverage across archetypes so replay differentiation regressions are easier to catch.
acceptanceCriteria: Define at least one operator-facing report comparing shaping echoes across archetype families
Surface obvious convergence or thin differentiation areas
Output references concrete event or summary surfaces
Save sample report under docs/test-reports/

userStories.title: P44 regression and closure
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want closure evidence that the operator audit tooling is usable and can catch real shaping-system regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Run typecheck
Run new audit tooling or tests
Demonstrate at least one real example per audit class
Save closure under docs/test-reports/p44-habit-audit-tooling-closure.md
Closure defines what still remains manual
